timingDefinition: Input-to-first-DOM-visible is measured from immediately before Playwright key input to first requestAnimationFrame sample with suggest widget rect, nonempty rows, display not none, visibility not hidden, opacity > 0. This is DOM/style visibility sampling, not a guarantee of physical paint completion.
